sentences.en: If you will be in the Midwest during the holidays, check out the Gifts of Christmas Holiday Light Parade, hosted twice each evening during Silver Dollar City's An Old Time Christmas celebration in Branson, Missouri.

sentences.en: By the time he was 10 years old, Donny's talent had taken him all over Texas and as far away as Branson, MO and Nashville, TN.
